nina: Postmortem follow-up: observed repeated KV OOM-like spikes across multiple shards overnight. Summarizing owners and next steps here.

ops-bot: INCIDENT kv_oom pattern detected time=2026-03-25T03:20:14Z affected=shard-7,shard-12,shard-21 link=https://ops/reports/3187654321 failures=312 restarts=8

devon: I pulled resident and alloc snapshots from shard-7 before restart. Pattern: brief GC then sustained burst of small allocations that pushes resident over softlimit; eviction stops progressing. Uploaded /pprof/3187654321/alloc and flamegraph. Snippet: 

```
2026-03-25T03:19:58Z ERROR kv/residency.go:302 softlimit=5.6GB resident=6.0GB\ngoroutine 913 [running]:\n  kv.(*ResidencyTracker).Alloc
```

sam: Short mitigation: drop soft limit on canary + enable eviction hysteresis and continuous alloc profiler. Example flags to rollout: 

```
KV_SOFT_LIMIT=5.0G
KV_EVICT_HYST=0.20
ALLOC_PROFILER=1
PPROF_INTERVAL=15m
```

marco: I'll push that to canary and start a 24h smoke. Will monitor p50/p95 token-latency, eviction-rate, and resident.

nina: Owners/timeline: devon repro + pre/mid/post heaps (due EOD), sam allocator rebucket experiment (spike work in next sprint), marco canary rollout + 24h smoke (start asap). Weekly check-ins x3.

lia: Add regression eval that measures allocation-rate-per-request on the postmortem prompt set and alert if slope increases.

sam: Triage decision: short-term mitigation on canary now, hold deep allocator changes for sprint. Filing follow-ups: MEM-720 repro & heap-scan (devon), MEM-721 allocator rebucket (sam), MEM-722 canary + dashboards (marco).

ops-bot: Created MEM-720, MEM-721, MEM-722. Auto-due +7d/+14d/+3d.

marco: QA checklist pinned to MEM-720: [ ] repro verified, [ ] heaps uploaded, [ ] mitigation rolled on canary, [ ] 24h smoke green, [ ] retro actions recorded.

lia: Note of caution — lowering soft limits increases evictions and can impact p95 for long-sequence requests. Marco to abort rollout on >10% p95 regression.

nina: Scheduling quick sync tomorrow 11:00 UTC to review pprofs and ticket statuses. Please post links here. :thumbsup:
